name: IndieTools

sources.title: Homepage — 'human-reviewed indie tools and startup directory'; 'free to join and free to stay', ~1100+ products
Submit page — requirements list, review process, Free vs Authority ($30 one-time) tiers; form lives at /dashboard/products/new

requirements: Accepts SaaS products, apps, developer tools, online services, courses, and other digital products
Product must be 'live enough for somebody outside your team to open, understand, and try or buy' — a live, publicly reachable website required
Accurate founder, category, platform, and technology details; logo plus product images/screenshots
Working links, no misleading claims or impersonation; duplicate listings are rejected in review
Account required — submission flow sits behind sign-in at /dashboard/products/new
preparation: Product URL, concise problem statement, and description
Founder name/details, category, platforms, and technology stack
Optional: $30 one-time 'Authority' upgrade adds a permanent followed link, SEO/GEO controls, a reviewed article, and a labelled 30-day Featured period
workflow: Fill the product record: URL, description, category, founder details, tech stack, images
Send to the review queue; manual review verifies the product is live/usable and may correct category, type, pricing, or copy
On approval the product gets a permanent public page; owners can edit the listing later
watchFor: Payment never influences approval — same review boundary for free and paid
Featured/ads are labelled placements and don't change organic ranking
Free tier link may be nofollow — the paid Authority tier is what advertises a 'permanent followed website link'
Dashboard URLs require auth — direct /dashboard/products/new without a session redirects to /signin
countsAsLive: The product has a public page under indietools.app/products and appears in category/discovery listings after review
unknowns: Whether the free tier's outbound link is nofollow (implied but not stated verbatim)
